name: thegentleminh
description: Free Claude Code skills from TheGentleMinh for YouTube creators

plugins.name: dung-video
plugins.description: Set up video editing with Claude Code and do basic edits with ffmpeg: trim, join, vertical Shorts, Vietnamese subtitles, loudness, YouTube export, thumbnail frames.

plugins.name: tach-nguoi
plugins.description: Person cut-out effects on your own clip: big text behind the person, freeze-frame character intro with a name card, freeze snap / comic freeze, clones. Vietnamese text done right.

plugins.name: ban-do
plugins.description: Animated map clips: zoom from a region to a country or city, highlight a country, a pin with a name, a big number that counts up; 9:16 or 16:9 MP4. Maps of Vietnam always show Hoàng Sa, Trường Sa and Biển Đông.

plugins.name: storykit-free
plugins.description: Install Roblox Studio and connect it to Claude Code through Roblox's Studio MCP server, with a connection check and a Vietnamese handbook. Unofficial; not affiliated with Roblox Corporation.

plugins.name: storykit
plugins.description: StoryKit (needs a StoryKit Pass): make Vietnamese 'Ở thế giới này…' story Shorts filmed in Roblox Studio, from a topic to a finished 9:16 video. This is the starter: connection check, setup and a download of the method from the Pass server. Unofficial; not affiliated with Roblox Corporation.
